sn35.9:1.10: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with the tongue of the past,
sn35.9:1.12: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding the tongue in the present.
sn35.9:1.16: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with the mind of the past,
sn35.9:1.18: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding the mind in the present.”
